## 1. Key Technical Claims by Article

### `article1_edge_ai.html` — The Rise of Edge AI Hardware

| Claim | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Hardware capability** | AMD Ryzen AI Max+ with 128GB unified memory achieves ~45 tokens/sec on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with iGPU |
| **Memory requirement** | 128GB unified memory enables fitting 30B+ parameter models locally, avoiding distributed inference latency |
| **MoE advantage** | Mixture-of-Experts models benefit: full model fits in memory but only ~3B parameters activate per token |
| **Latency threshold** | TTFT under 500ms = "instant" to users; with prefix caching, sub-200ms TTFT achievable for long-context tasks |
| **Viability** | "Always-on" AI agent paradigm now viable on consumer hardware |
